interval_method: 95% Wilson binomial intervals on genuine binomial counts only. The Wilson intervals on interval_coverage_observed have been DELETED: that count is a deterministic function of N and alpha under in-sample rank calibration (fix-queue item 5d / F1-11). Conditional false-adapt now carries a one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson UPPER bound, computed as scipy.stats.beta.ppf(0.95, k+1, n-k).

fa_u_identity_note: Under IN-SAMPLE rank calibration eps is the k-th order statistic of the same residual vector it tests, so the miscoverage count is identically n-k and FA_u <= (n-k)/n holds for any data (0.0972 at n=432, 0.0370 at n=27, exactly 0 at n in {9,12,18} where k=n). Under the promoted leave-one-out-of-pool calibration the identity is broken and FA_u becomes a measurement; CIFAR-10-C still measures 0 over 9504 cells, ImageNet-C SAR measures 1/135.
guarantee_untested_rule: tracks with fewer than 10 ADAPT decisions are marked 'guarantee untested'
aggregate_provenance_rule: ONE aggregate per row, and the row states which artifact tree it came from. Resolved 2026-07-26 (fix-queue defect F). The CIFAR-10-C rows previously recorded 1109 (Tent) and 1243 (EATA) ADAPT decisions while the paper printed 1113 and 1244. Both were real numbers of different things. 1109 = the stress_grid_multiseed_v1 five-seed aggregate under the ARCHIVED INTERPOLATED quantile, assembled as seed 0's stored summary (221 adapts, read from seed0/decisive_tta_results.json because seed 0 ships no per-condition dump) plus seeds 1-4 recomputed from their per-condition dumps (888 adapts) = 1109; likewise EATA 242 + 1001 = 1243. 1113 = the mixed_headtohead_v1 five-seed aggregate under the DECLARED exact-rank rule, recomputed cell by cell from all five per-condition dumps; likewise EATA 1244. The paper promotes mixed_headtohead_v1 under the declared rule, so these rows now do too, and the reproduction command reproduces them. The old glob was also self-inconsistent: it matched only 4 files (1728 cells) while the row claimed n_decisions 2160.
